metadata.name: Feature Implementation Goals
metadata.description: Goals for implementing the user authentication feature
metadata.author: development-team

goals.objective: Set up the SQLite database with required tables for user authentication

success: Users table exists with correct schema
Sessions table exists with correct schema
acceptance: Database can be opened and queried

goals.objective: Implement a secure user login system with email and password authentication

success: Users can log in with valid credentials
Invalid credentials return appropriate error messages
Session tokens are securely generated and stored
acceptance: No plaintext passwords in logs or storage

constraints: Must use bcrypt for password hashing
Session tokens must expire after 24 hours

goals.objective: Implement user logout functionality that invalidates the current session

success: Users can log out from any authenticated page
Session tokens are invalidated on logout
Subsequent requests with old token are rejected

goals.objective: Create session management utilities for checking and refreshing user sessions

success: Sessions can be refreshed before expiry
Expired sessions are properly cleaned up

goals.objective: Implement rate limiting on authentication endpoints to prevent brute force attacks

success: Login attempts are limited per IP address
Rate limit headers are included in responses
